title: Magical Keto Bread
description: A delicious and crispy bread recipe, perfect for keto dieters. This magical bread is made with a unique blend of ingredients that will make you wonder how you ever lived without it.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the malaysian and crusty ingredients.
Add the bread loaf to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and crispy.
While the bread is baking, mix the magical ingredient in a small bowl.
Once the bread is done, brush the magical mixture onto the top of the bread.
